The latest introduces update counts but leaves the procedure unspecified. This coaching narrows the object to a hypothetical visual trace, distinct from the earlier weight-calculation exercise. Supplied Astra7 returns ask about network conditions; they establish neither a count nor an optimizer update.

assessment.message: P7, “相同的优化变量更新数量” gives you something countable, but “increment size” needs a definition. Make a small hypothetical tracing task: six examples processed once, one update after each group, comparing group sizes two and three. Put your actual English parenting prompt here, asking Astra7 to draw the group boundaries and mark each update before comparing totals. Leave the counts to your child. Its supplied network-conditions question does not yet answer this task; inspect the returned trace rather than treating another proposal as a result.
